title: Dating App Reality Check: see where your month breaks
description: Enter last month's app hours, matches, conversations and dates. See your own funnel, where it breaks, and three next steps for that stage. 18+.

title: Same-Fight Map: a calm conversation plan for couples
description: Map the fight you keep having: the trigger, what each of you says and needs, how it ends. Get a printable plan for one calm talk. Couples, 18+.

title: New-City Friendship Planner: a 4-week plan for real friends
description: Pick your interests, free evenings and neighborhood. Get a 4-week plan built on seeing the same people every week, plus a tracker for names you meet.

title: Evening Phone Audit: see the hours your phone takes
description: Enter your screen-time numbers and what you would rather do. See hours lost per month and year, plus a personal evening rule and a phone parking plan.

title: Tomorrow List: a 5-minute brain dump before bed
description: A timed 5-minute brain dump that sorts each thought into tomorrow, someday or not mine to fix, then gives you a printable list to leave by the bed.

title: Why I Quit: find your exercise pattern and a 2-week plan
description: List the times you started exercising and why each one stopped. See your main pattern and get a minimum routine for the next 2 weeks that fits it.

title: Next 30 Days Money Map: find your lowest point
description: Enter your balance, paydays, bills and everyday spending. See a day-by-day timeline, your lowest point, and what is truly free to spend. Not advice.

title: Job Application Funnel Check: find where yours leaks
description: Count your applications, responses, screens, interviews and offers, and how you applied. See which stage leaks and what to do next for that stage.

title: Start-It Timer: a 2-minute first step, then 10 minutes of focus
description: Type the task you keep avoiding. Turn it into a 2-minute first action, then run a 10-minute focus timer and keep a log of what you got done.

title: Care Load Inventory: see every hour of caring for a parent
description: List every care task, its hours per week and who does it. See your total care load, what could be shared, delegated or outsourced, and a printable list.
